AI 分析和 Agent 对话会发送骨架数据与查看的截图。Agent 需要支持图: AI analysis and Agent conversations send skeleton data and inspection images to your API. The model must support images and tool calls. Original GLB files stay on your computer.
AI 分析并生成方案: Analyze with AI and create a plan
Enter 发送 · Shift + Enter 换行: Enter to send · Shift + Enter for a new line
Meshy 会依次生成几何并制作纹理。: Meshy generates geometry first, then textures.
为这个角色适配骨架: Fit a skeleton to this character
从此模型创建编辑节点: Create an editing node from this model
从画布移除节点（模型文件保留）: Remove node from canvas (keep model file)
使用你希望保留的外观: Use the appearance you want to keep
使用系统安全存储记住密钥: Remember keys using system secure storage
例如：四足角色，保留长尾；注意胸毛与下巴的间隙: Example: a quadruped with a long tail; check the gap between chest fur and chin
例如：站姿的小龙，双臂分开，完整身体与尾巴，适合骨骼绑定: Example: a standing baby dragon, arms apart, full body and tail, suitable for rigging
例如：脖子关节太低，先检查侧视图，再调整并重绑。: Example: the neck joint is too low. Inspect the side view, adjust it, then rebind.
保留原始模型 · 每次输出新版本: Keep originals · Create a new version each time
保留现有骨骼和权重，建立动作对应关系。: Keep the existing skeleton and weights, and map the animations.
先不要执行，解释当前方案里尾巴的骨骼是怎么对应的。: Do not execute yet. Explain how the tail bones are mapped in this plan.
先导入动作原型和目标模型: Import an animation source and a target model first
减面在绑骨前执行。带形态键的网格会跳过减面。: Decimation runs before rigging. Meshes with shape keys skip decimation.
动作来自当前原型，可以只处理需要的部分。: Animations come from the selected source. Choose only the clips you need.
发送骨架摘要与预览图 · 不上传完整模型: Send skeleton summaries and previews · No full-model upload
可从 AI 分析或本地草案开始。猫、狗、龙等不同结构使用各自的关节方案。: Start with AI analysis or a local draft. Adapt joints to each character, whether a cat, dog, dragon or another shape.
可新增、删除骨骼并修改父子关系。坐标使用模型世界空间，Y 向上。: Add or remove bones and edit parent relationships. Coordinates are in model world space, Y-up.
可让 Agent 分析模型后创建方案。: Ask the Agent to inspect the models and create a plan.
告诉我，你想怎么改。: Tell me what you would like to change.
在 Agent 对话里描述改形、权重、UV、材质或表情需求。每次执行保存新的结果: Describe mesh, weight, UV, material or expression changes to the Agent. Each execution saves a new result.
填写支持图像输入的模型名称: Enter a model ID that supports image input
填写需要使用的服务密钥。点击“生成模型”才会提交收费任务；画布连线不会自动生成。: Enter keys for the services you use. Only clicking Generate submits a paid task; connecting nodes does not.
完成第一次绑定后，结果会自动保存在这里。: Results appear here after your first successful binding.
完成绑定后，这里会显示动作、体积以及可疑接触提示。: After binding, review animations, file size and possible contact issues here.
密钥不会写入模型或处理日志: Keys are not written into models or processing logs
对话、骨架数据及请求查看的截图会发往你配置的 API；GLB 留在本机。: Conversations, skeleton data and requested inspection images go to your configured API; GLB files stay local.
导入原型和目标，连接绑定节点。每次编辑都会留下独立结果，随时分支与对比。: Import a source and target, then connect a binding node. Each edit creates a separate result you can branch and compare.
导入模型 → 校正骨骼 → 本地绑定 → 同步对比: Import → Adjust joints → Bind locally → Compare
已生成 · 可创建分支: Generated · Create a branch to continue
当前为界面预览。请通过桌面应用打开，以调用本地 Blender 和导入模型。: Interface preview only. Open the desktop app to use local Blender and import models.
当前系统安全存储不可用，密钥仅保留在本次运行内存中。: System secure storage is unavailable. Keys are kept only in memory for this session.
执行前会检查骨骼名称、坐标和循环关系: Bone names, coordinates and parent cycles are checked before execution
拖动旋转 · 滚轮缩放: Drag to rotate · Scroll to zoom
拖动端口连接 · 双击连线移除 ·: Connect ports by dragging · Double-click an edge to remove ·
文件检查与动作观察共同决定这个版本是否适合使用。: Use both data checks and visual animation review to decide whether a result is ready.
新骨架使用 Blender 自动权重。大头、长毛、翅膀等部位仍需在动态对比中检查: New skeletons use Blender automatic weights. Inspect large heads, long fur and wings during playback. Animation transfer does not create blinking or mouth shape keys automatically.
根据目标外形调整关节位置，建立新的蒙皮绑定。: Adjust joints to the target shape and create new skinning weights.
检查双臂网格，局部延长 15%，保持肩部过渡并检查纹理。: Inspect the arm meshes, lengthen them by 15%, preserve a smooth shoulder transition and check textures.
检查当前节点及其输入，拟合骨架并绑定所选动作。: Inspect this node and its inputs, fit the skeleton and bind the selected animations.
模型处理在本机执行，完成后将自动生成独立版本。: Models are processed on your computer. A separate version is created when processing completes.
每轮 Blender 编辑 / 绑定尝试次数: Blender editing / binding attempts per turn
独立保存模型、方案和 Blender 工程，随时回到之前的版本。: Models, plans and Blender projects are saved separately, so you can return to earlier versions.
留空保留现有密钥: Leave blank to keep the existing key
目标已有绑定，保留拓扑和权重。: The target is already rigged. Preserve topology and weights.
脚本使用 Blender 的 Z 向上坐标，可用 to_blender / to: Scripts use Blender Z-up coordinates. Use to_blender / to_gltf to convert. The workspace saves outputs.
让新的角色，动起来。: Bring a new character to life.
请先在应用设置中填写该服务的 API Key。: Enter this service's API key in application settings first.
请通过桌面应用启动，以访问本地 Blender 与模型文件。: Open the desktop app to access local Blender and model files.
输入保留在此节点，输出单独保存；拖动或连线不会提交生成任务。: Inputs stay in this node; outputs are saved separately. Moving or connecting nodes does not submit generation tasks.
达到上限后保留结果，可继续发送指令。步数更多会增加耗时和 API 用量。: Completed results are kept when a limit is reached. Send another instruction to continue. Higher limits increase time and API usage.
这是输入模型，执行编辑或绑定后会生成独立报告。: This is an input model. Editing or binding creates a separate inspection report.
选中原型、目标、绑定或编辑节点，再描述你希望修改的部分。: Select a source, target, binding or editing node, then describe what you want to change.
选中画布节点后，我可以调用 Blender 编辑局部网格、权重、骨骼、UV、材质: Select a canvas node. I can use Blender to edit mesh regions, weights, bones, UVs, materials and expressions, then save a separate version for comparison.
选择一个模型节点开始预览。可将原型和两个结果加入对比。: Select a model node to preview it. Add a source and up to two results for comparison.
选择一个节点查看设置: Select a node to see its settings
选择本机安装的 Blender。绑定、减面、烘焙和导出在电脑上执行。: Select your local Blender installation. Rigging, decimation, baking and export run on your computer.
选择结果节点查看检查报告: Select a result node to inspect it
AI 方案已生成，请检查关节位置: AI plan created. Check the joint positions.
最多对比三个模型，请先移出一个: Compare up to three models. Remove one first.
模型尚未加载完成，无法截图: The model has not finished loading. Capture is unavailable.
没有发现 Blender，请手动选择安装路径: Blender was not found. Select its installation path.
独立版本已生成，可与原型同步对比: A separate version is ready for synchronized comparison.
至少需要一个骨骼: At least one bone is required
请使用贴图内嵌的 GLB 文件: Use a GLB with embedded textures
AI 没有返回有效的 JSON 绑定方案，请检查模型是否支持结构化输出: AI did not return a valid JSON rigging plan. Check whether the model supports structured output.
API 地址不能包含账号、查询参数或片段: API URLs cannot contain credentials, query parameters or fragments.
API 未返回可读取的回复: The API returned no readable reply.
Agent 正在运行，请先等待完成或停止: Agent is running. Wait for it to finish or stop it first.
Agent 步数应为 1–100，Blender 尝试次数为 1–30: Agent steps must be 1–100 and Blender attempts must be 1–30.
不允许从内部网络地址下载模型: Downloading models from private network addresses is not allowed.
不能手动创建结果记录: Result records cannot be created manually.
不能连接节点自身: A node cannot connect to itself.
任务已取消或超过 30 分钟: Task canceled or the 30-minute limit was reached.
任务服务与节点配置不同，请恢复原服务或创建分支: The task provider differs from this node. Restore the original provider or create a branch.
关节修改必须是数组: Joint edits must be an array.
动作原型必须包含动作: The animation source must contain animations.
动作名称不在源模型中: The animation name is not present in the source model.
动作源没有骨架: The animation source has no skeleton.
动作相位应为 0–1: Animation phase must be between 0 and 1.
只能编辑目标或结果副本: Only copies of target or result models can be edited.
工具参数必须是对象: Tool arguments must be an object.
工具参数无效或过大: Tool arguments are invalid or too large.
已有任务正在运行，请等待完成或停止: A task is already running. Wait for it to finish or stop it.
已有任务运行中，请等待完成或取消: A task is already running. Wait for it to finish or cancel it.
已有有效蒙皮仅支持动作对应修改，关节位置和权重保持原样: An already skinned model supports animation remapping only; joint positions and weights remain unchanged.
已有有效蒙皮的关节位置和层级必须保留；当前仅支持修改动作对应关系: Preserve joint positions and hierarchy for an already skinned model; only animation remapping is supported here.
已有有效蒙皮的目标不支持自动减面: Automatic decimation is not supported for an already skinned target.
已有本地任务执行中: A local task is already running.
所选节点没有这个模型: This model does not belong to the selected node.
接口未返回 Chat Completions message: The API did not return a Chat Completions message.
接口未返回 Responses output，请检查接口模式: The API did not return Responses output. Check the API mode.
新骨架至少需要一个启用变形的骨骼: A new skeleton needs at least one deforming bone.
方案文件过大: The plan file is too large.
无法下载生成的 GLB: Could not download the generated GLB.
无法读取 Blender 版本: Could not read the Blender version.
最多同时对比三个模型: Compare up to three models at a time.
未找到同名骨骼，请使用 AI 分析，或导入/编辑对应方案: No matching bone names were found. Use AI analysis or import/edit a mapping plan.
本轮 Blender 执行次数已达上限: The Blender execution limit for this turn has been reached.
本轮图像检查次数已达上限，请根据已有图像完成本轮: The image inspection limit has been reached. Complete this turn using the existing images.
本轮已达到三次绑定尝试或配置的 Blender 上限，请总结后继续下一轮: Three binding attempts or the configured Blender limit has been reached. Summarize and continue in a new turn.
查询已超过 45 分钟；任务编号已保存，可稍后继续查询: Polling exceeded 45 minutes. The task ID is saved; resume polling later.
检查视角或贴图数量无效: Invalid inspection view or texture count.
模型一次请求了过多工具，请缩小任务后重试: The model requested too many tools at once. Try a smaller task.
模型下载地址必须为公共 HTTPS: Model downloads require a public HTTPS URL.
模型回复未完成，请缩小本次修改范围后重试: The model response was incomplete. Try a smaller edit.
模型未提供有效工具调用 ID: The model did not provide a valid tool-call ID.
模型未返回文字或工具调用: The model returned no text or tool calls.
模型记录不存在，请重新导入: Model record not found. Import the model again.
模型超过 512 MB，请先优化: The model exceeds 512 MB. Optimize it first.
模型预览尚未就绪，未获得两张图像: The model preview is not ready; two inspection images were not obtained.
没有可编辑的模型: No model is available for editing.
生成接口未返回任务编号: The generation API did not return a task ID.
目标骨骼名称为空、过长或重复: Target bone names are empty, too long or duplicated.
系统安全存储不可用，可取消记住密钥并仅在本次运行使用: System secure storage is unavailable. Disable Remember key to use session-only keys.
结果来源记录不能单独删除: A result's provenance connection cannot be deleted separately.
节点类型无效或已达到 1000 个节点: Invalid node type or the 1,000-node limit has been reached.
该模型没有此动作，不能伪装成动作截图: This model lacks the requested animation. A static image cannot be presented as an animation capture.
请从模型或结果节点输出连接: Connect from a model or result node.
请使用 Blender 4.2 或更新版本（推荐 4.5 LTS）: Use Blender 4.2 or newer; 4.5 LTS is recommended.
请使用 HTTPS，或本机 HTTP 接口: Use HTTPS or a local HTTP endpoint.
请先创建并校正骨骼方案: Create and adjust a rigging plan first.
请先在设置中填写 API 地址、模型名和 Key: Enter an API URL, model ID and key in Settings first.
请先填写并保存 API Key 和模型名: Enter and save an API key and model ID first.
请在设置中选择本机 Blender: Select your local Blender installation in Settings.
请填写 1–6000 字的模型描述: Enter a model description of 1–6,000 characters.
请连接带动作的原型与目标模型，再执行绑定操作: Connect an animated source and a target model before binding.
请连接绑定节点的原型/目标端口，或编辑节点的输入端口: Connect to a binding node's Source/Target port, or an editing node's Input port.
请选择绑定、编辑、生成或结果节点创建分支: Choose a binding, editing, generation or result node to branch from.
请选择绑定、编辑或生成节点: Choose a binding, editing or generation node.
这个节点已有结果，请创建分支后再次生成: This node already has a result. Create a branch to generate again.
这个节点已有远程任务，请继续查询，或创建分支发起新任务: This node already has a remote task. Resume polling or create a branch for a new task.
这个节点没有可继续查询的任务: This node has no task to resume.
这对模型尚无所选结果: This model pair has no selected result.
远程任务完成但没有 GLB 下载地址: The remote task completed without a GLB download URL.
连接会产生循环: The connection would create a cycle.
采样率或减面比例无效: Invalid sampling rate or decimation ratio.
骨架包含父子循环: The skeleton contains a parent cycle.
